stem:
In each diagram, line p is parallel to line f, and line t intersects lines p and f.

Based on these diagrams, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The value of x should be 75, because the angles shown in the diagrams are congruent.

options.label: B
options.text: The value of x should be 105, because the measures of the angles shown in the diagrams add up to 180°.

options.label: C
options.text: The value of x should be 140, because the measures of the angles shown in the diagrams should add up to 360° and 360  − (110 + 110) = 140.

options.label: D
options.text: The value of x should be 70, because the measures of the angles shown in the diagrams are both 70°.

visual_elements:
Four diagrams, each showing lines p and f parallel, intersected by line t.
1. Two lines p and f with angles 70° indicated on alternate interior angles.
2. Two lines p and f with right angles indicated.
3. Two lines p and f with angles 110° indicated on alternate interior angles.
4. Two lines p and f with angle 75° on p and angle x° on f.
